note: A village tradition known mostly through field recordings by anonymous troupes; the 1979 Ahwach LP and the Folkways and Bowles anthologies are the best entry points.

size.basis: Published LP/CD field recordings found: about a dozen tracks across five or six releases; the CREM-CNRS archive alone holds dozens of unpublished ahwash and ahidus items (e.g. multiple AHIDUS and AHWAS series from 1969-1979), the Lomax 1967 Morocco set has 15+ ahwash parts, and a local cassette/online market of named troupes (e.g. Khenifra bendir singers) adds an uncounted body. Core = the handful of anthologised tracks and the 1979 Ahwach LP.
